### Video render control page

| Address | Size | Field | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$00020` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_MODE_OFFSET` | Video enable and renderer mode bits (MIA_VIDEO_MODE_*). |
| `$00021` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_LAYER_ENABLE_OFFSET` | Background, overlay and sprite enables (MIA_VIDEO_LAYER_*). |
| `$00022` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_BG_VIEWPORT_MODE_OFFSET` | Viewport mapping within the active background set, 0-5. |
| `$00023` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_BG_ACTIVE_SET_OFFSET` | Background table set, 0 or 1. |
| `$00024-$00025` | 2 | `MIA_VIDEO_SCROLL_X_OFFSET` | Viewport X position in the active background plane, pixels, little-endian. |
| `$00026-$00027` | 2 | `MIA_VIDEO_SCROLL_Y_OFFSET` | Viewport Y position in the active background plane, pixels, little-endian. |
| `$00028` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_BG_CHR_BANK_OFFSET` | Primary background CHR bank, 0-7. |
| `$00029` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_BG_ALT_CHR_BANK_OFFSET` | Alternate background CHR bank, 0-7, for cells with CHR_ALT set. |
| `$0002A` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_OVERLAY_CHR_BANK_OFFSET` | Primary overlay CHR bank, 0-7. |
| `$0002B` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_OVERLAY_ALT_CHR_BANK_OFFSET` | Alternate overlay CHR bank, 0-7, for cells with CHR_ALT set. |
| `$0002C` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_SPRITE_CHR_BANK_OFFSET` | Sprite CHR bank, 0-7. |
| `$0002D` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_CHR_1BPP_MASK_OFFSET` | Bit n set decodes CHR bank n as 1bpp instead of 3bpp. |
| `$0002E` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_CHR_1BPP_PLANES_OFFSET` | 1bpp plane selectors, 0-2 each: background bits 0-1, sprites bits 2-3, overlay bits 4-5. |
| `$0002F` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_BACKDROP_COLOR_OFFSET` | Backdrop color: color index in bits 0-2, palette bank in bits 3-6. |
| `$00030` | 1 | `MIA_VIDEO_OAM_LAST_INDEX_OFFSET` | Last OAM record the renderer evaluates while sprites are enabled. |

Video mode bits (`MIA_VIDEO_MODE_OFFSET`):

| Bit | Mask | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `%00000001` | `MIA_VIDEO_MODE_ENABLE` | Video service enabled. |

Layer enable bits (`MIA_VIDEO_LAYER_ENABLE_OFFSET`):

| Bit | Mask | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `%00000001` | `MIA_VIDEO_LAYER_BACKGROUND` | Background layer enabled. |
| 1 | `%00000010` | `MIA_VIDEO_LAYER_OVERLAY` | Overlay layer enabled. |
| 2 | `%00000100` | `MIA_VIDEO_LAYER_SPRITES` | Sprite layer enabled. |
